verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਅਨੁਚਰ ਨਰਪਤਿ ਕੀ ਪਛਾਨੈਂ ਭਾਖਾ ਬੋਲਤ ਬਚਨ ਖਿਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਬਿਨ ਦੇਖ ਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise anuchar narapat kee pachhaanai(n) bhaakhaa bolat bachan khin boojhai bin dhekh hee ||

en.bdb: Just as an attendant on king waits behind him and recognises his sound and utterances without even seeing the king.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਜੌਹਰੀ ਪਰਖ ਜਾਨਤ ਹੈ ਰਤਨ ਕੀ ਦੇਖਤ ਹੀ ਕਹੈ ਖਰੋ ਖੋਟੋ ਰੂਪ ਰੇਖ ਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise jauaharee parakh jaanat hai ratan kee dhekhat hee kahai kharo khoTo roop rekh hee ||

en.bdb: Just as a gemologist knows the art of evaluating the precious stones and is able to declare whether a stone is fake or genuine by a look on its form.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਖੀਰ ਨੀਰ ਕੋ ਨਿਬੇਰੋ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨੈ ਹੰਸ ਰਾਖੀਐ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਭਿੰਨ ਭਿੰਨ ਕੈ ਸਰੇਖ ਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise kheer neer ko nibero kar jaanai ha(n)s raakheeaai milai bhi(n)n bhi(n)n kai sarekh hee ||

en.bdb: Just as a swan knows how to separate milk and water and is able to do in no time.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਨਤ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੈ ਸਿਖ ਆਨ ਬਾਨੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਤਮੀ ਨ ਗਨਤ ਹੈ ਲੇਖ ਹੀ ॥੫੭੦॥
verses.translit_en: taise gur sabadh sunat pahichaanai sikh aan baanee kiratamee na ganat hai lekh hee ||570||

en.bdb: Similarly, a true Sikh of the True Guru recognises which composition is fake and which one is genuine, created by the True Guru as soon as he hears it. He discards what is not genuine in no time and keeps it in no account.  (570)
